title: reader.json
description: The reader node's typed frame of the founder who reads the page: who they are, what the posting asks of the hire, what the company says about itself, and what the founder already knows. The lock, the screeners and rank read it; code sets recipient.confidence and seeds constraints from rulings.tsv.

name.description: Verbatim, as on the company's own site.

domain.description: The registrable domain; a row on it or a subdomain is known.

hosts.description: Every host of the company's own pages the run fetched.

kind.description: The seat's family, the title's slug before any ' - ' qualifier.

name.description: null when confidence is unresolved; the page then addresses the title.

confidence.description: Set by code from the source rows' states and hosts (c2 § 7).

writing.description: Rows citing the recipient's own public writing.

taste_model.description: generic when writing is empty: the card runs unmodified and the check-in flags it.

line.description: The line of the job ad's capture the text sits on.

weight.description: From the posting's own headings: 3 a duty bullet, 2 the role framing, 1 a requirement.

text.description: The company's or founder's own line, verbatim.

ruling.description: The rulings.tsv id the constraint is seeded from; null for one the run's own rows state.

known_hosts.description: Hosts matched exactly when code sets a claim row's known: the company's hosts and the job ad's host. A shared platform host (a Notion or ATS site) stays exact, never a suffix.

known_summary.description: What the founder already holds, in one paragraph.
